english.notes: No minimum published (re-read 2026-10-20). https://admissions.yale.edu/international: a test is required of non-native speakers without two years of English-medium secondary school (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge English Qualifications, DET, InitialView). https://admissions.yale.edu/standardized-testing gives only benchmarks: 'Yale's most competitive applicants typically earn a score of 5 or higher (for tests taken after January 21, 2026) or at least 100 (for tests taken before January 21, 2026)' for TOEFL. Not a minimum.
